notes: Page title: 'Cheesy Sandwiches', plus 'Twisted Sw's' section. Branded with 'Junktion77 - The Foodies' Crossroads' logo top-right. Dark olive-green background with gear pattern; headings in red/crimson decorative calligraphic serif; item names bold tan/gold serif; descriptions small white sans-serif; prices tan with '/-'. Green/red circular veg/non-veg markers; 'Pesto veg sandwich / Pesto Chicken Sandwich' and 'Crispy Veg / Crispy Nonveg Sandwich' have no marker; 'Omlette Sandwich Veg / Non Veg' has a red marker. Intro: 'Life is like a sandwich,the more you add the better it is. (All the sandwiches are double cheese sandwiches made with white bread)'. Note: Olives / Jalapenos topping is 30/- here vs 40/- on menu-07. Bottom photo: grilled white-bread sandwich with chips, ketchup and green chutney. No tax/charges text. Fully legible.
